research_question: Does working-memory load modulate fronto-parietal coupling in a fixture fMRI cohort?
falsifiability_criteria: If coupling does not increase with load at the preregistered threshold, the hypothesis is falsified.
primary_endpoint: Slope of fronto-parietal coupling against memory load level

null_model.description: load labels permuted within subject, 1000 permutations

known_leakage_risks: repeated runs from one subject could leak identity across folds

split_strategy.method: five-fold grouped cross-validation by subject identifier

claim_language: We hypothesize that coupling tracks memory load; this is a correlational, exploratory analysis.
replication_plan: Replicate on an independent cohort before any confirmatory claim.
